endorsements.quote: Transparency in model development: maintain clear documentation of model architectures, training procedures, data sources, and limitations to facilitate critical evaluation and replication efforts.
Continuous monitoring and updating: establish mechanisms for ongoing performance monitoring in real-world settings and update models as new data and insights emerge.
The first step is to define the context of use for that predictor.
Education and training: implement educational initiatives to enhance understanding of ML predictor development, validation, and credibility assessment among researchers, clinicians, and stakeholders.

unlisted_practices: Develop standardized credibility assessment protocols tailored to ML predictors using the seven-step process.
Add a safety layer that compares a subject's data with the training and test distributions and refuses to predict or warns users when the subject is out of distribution.
Collect and store all potentially relevant observable variables for every subject in training and test sets to enable applicability analysis.
Decompose ML predictor prediction error into its sources and check that each component follows its expected distribution.
Use true reference values from measurement chains at least one order of magnitude more accurate than the maximum acceptable error.
Adopt a total product life cycle approach, certifying ML predictors for contexts resembling their test sets and broadening the context of use as more diverse test sets are added.
Implement feedback mechanisms for users to report discrepancies or errors in ML predictors.
Use interpretable ML models or techniques that provide insight into model decisions.
Foster interdisciplinary collaboration among data scientists, domain experts, clinicians, and regulators.
Collaborate with regulatory agencies to align credibility assessment methods with compliance requirements.
Invest in research on validation, verification, and uncertainty quantification methods adapted to ML predictors.
Consider hybrid modeling combining biophysical models and ML, such as physics-informed machine learning, to improve credibility.

screen.reason: This is a consensus statement/position paper providing 12 key recommendations/guidelines on the credibility assessment and deployment of machine learning predictors in healthcare.
